detail.longDescription: Lexica Ultralegible builds on the Braille Institute's Atkinson Hyperlegible with 589 glyphs per font, support for 102 languages, standard ligatures, updated kerning, and an alternative zero, and it's free under the Open Font License. https:// coywolf.com/news/web-developme nt/lexica-ultralegible-is-a-new-font-for-low-vision-readers-based-on-atkinson-hyper/ # Accessibility # Fonts # WebDev
